verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a CDP and event pipeline, so autonomous AI decisioning (per-customer next-best message, timing and channel within guardrails, with measured lift) is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents only data collection, transformation Functions, profile building and warehouse delivery. Its MCP server lets AI agents manage pipeline configuration, which is a different capability from customer-level decisioning and earns no credit here. Nothing in the pack shows decisioning agents, guardrails, orchestration across channels, or lift measurement.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI decisioning agents pick messages, timing, and channels per customer autonomously within guardrails I set, with measurable lift
